instruction: I keep a monthly log of total expenses I made on Amazon in a SimpleNote note. Update it with this month's entry.
notes: No question is asked, so complete_task carries no answer; its two parameters are task records (the note and the appended entry), not API arguments. The agent must read the note (show_note) to learn the exact existing line format ("- <Month YYYY> => $<amount>") and then append one line for May 2023 with this month's Amazon order total (sum of totals of orders placed in 2023-05 from amazon.show_orders, paginating if needed). Appending with add_content_to_note keeps the title line first and leaves title/tags/pinned unchanged, as the evaluation requires; update_note with full content would also work but is not modeled. Only one simple_note.Note record may change.
